data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (weather 10-day lookup, BBC '<city> strike' search with the top article, then a mail draft with the matching subject and body template), but it loses detail in three places: it ends with 'Discard or send' when the draft must be discarded and never sent; it lists derived values (forecast, headline) as input parameters; and it splits the recipient into separate email and name parameters instead of building the address as {traveler}@example.com.
